correctness.rationale: Every group power has multiplier u^e and translation coefficient b(1+u+...+u^(e-1)); finite cyclic unit decomposition gives exactly h p^d multiplier roots and h residue classes, and odd-prime LTE distinguishes the unique residue-one class from the h-1 other classes. Each scalar equation has p^valuation roots exactly when the target meets the same ideal constraint. This yields all target counts and the image formula with boundary s>=m included; terminal statements follow by substitution. The standalone exhaustive direct-product checker passes 280 (p,m,e) parameter cases over p=3,5,7,11. Computation is a finite consistency test, not an infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The family G has normal p-Sylow P and tame cyclic quotient C_{p-1}. General p-group theorems can subsume some counts for root targets inside P when the exponent is p-primary, a known part credited here. For arbitrary e, every residue-1 multiplier has h distinct roots mod p, of which h-1 have a different geometric-sum valuation from the principal root. Without that distinction, prior formulas cannot imply the e.g. identity spike 1+(p-2)p^m of the (p-1)-power map. Generic character identities may calculate any finite-group root number given additional power-class data, but the inspected character table does not evaluate it.

originality.rationale: The all-exponent prescribed-target formula was checked against publicly available holomorph presentations, metacyclic p-group element-order lemmas, the cyclic-holomorph orbit partition, same-object representation and regular-subgroup results, a complete affine-chain-ring character table, and the closest published all-exponent power-fiber theorem for different quiver unit groups. The comparison concerns implications: general p-group power results handle some principal-unit roots but not the nonuniform h-1 tame residue families at arbitrary target (t,v); a character table does not itself specify these evaluated power fibers. No checked source states or obviously dominates this exact all-depth formula; missing/unindexed priority remains an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed or non-open-access literature may contain the same all-exponent evaluated metacyclic-group word fibers.
Some metacyclic or regular p-group power-order results imply principal-Sylow special cases; these are not claimed new.
A general finite-group character-based evaluation might yield an equivalent formula after substantial simplification; no matching closed valuation formula was located.
The p=2 and noncyclic chain-ring cases are excluded.
Independent mathematical review has not been performed.

value.rationale: The full family of arbitrary power-word fibers N_e(t,v) is an intrinsic group invariant for an unbounded family of nonabelian cyclic holomorphs. It distinguishes the nonuniform contributions of tame and principal multiplier roots, gives all exact image-cardinalities and a sharp terminal p-to-1 collapse, and exhibits modulus-depth-independent image density at fixed exponent. These are nontrivial specified-target data beyond known element orders, conjugacy spectra and yes/no power-image criteria. The field-level and principal p-subgroup cases are expressly not priority claims.
